description: Scan and redact assembled prompt bytes for credentials before any provider dispatch. lib/step-prompt.js concatenates every docs/context/*.md in full into the prompt and ships it to a paid provider; nothing in compose scans or redacts prompt CONTENT (stratum scrubs env vars only, ts/src/connectors/base.ts:16). A credential in any context doc silently leaves the machine. Needs a pre-dispatch scan of the final assembled bytes, redaction with a visible marker, and a loud local failure rather than a silent send. Sized S.
